verseText: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
meaning: God created human beings in his likeness. That makes us special. We are more like God than any of the other creatures he made.

recall.question: In whose image were humans created?

meaning.question: What does being made in God's image mean?
choices: Human beings have special dignity and likeness to God
Humans are just like every animal

application.prompt: Treat another person with respect today because they are made in God's image.
